newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE draft law seeks bank capital rise to $27 mln.
newsitem.headline: UAE draft law seeks bank capital rise to $27 mln.

text.p: The UAE is debating a draft law which would require all banks to increase their capital to 100 million dirhams ($27 million) from a current minimum of 40 million dirhams, the daily Al-Bayan said on Monday.

The paper said the United Arab Emirates' ministry of state for cabinet affairs had sent the draft law to the justice ministry as a preliminary step towards receiving final approval from the council of ministers.
The draft law would also require foreign banks to purchase central bank certificates of deposit worth 100 million dirhams.

According to the proposed law, banks and financial institutions would have to meet the new requirements within three years of the implementation of the law. ($1=3.67 dirhams) -- Dubai newsroom +9714 6071 222
